subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Tenth graders read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poems, at the high end of the grades 9-10 complexity band, independently and proficiently, applying all skills: theme, complex character, figurative language, structure, point of view, and strong evidence.

items.prompt:
Read.

The lawyer took the hopeless case no one else would touch, knowing it would cost him clients and comfort.

What does this reveal about him, and what theme emerges?

steps: He sacrificed his own gain for an unpopular just cause.
So he is principled, and the theme is that justice sometimes demands personal sacrifice.
solution.answer: He is principled; theme: justice can demand personal sacrifice.

items.prompt:
Read.

The drought had turned the fields to bone, the river to a memory.

Identify the figurative device and its effect.

steps: 'Fields to bone' and 'river to a memory' are metaphors.
They convey total barrenness and loss.
So the metaphors convey devastating barrenness.
solution.answer: Metaphors conveying devastating barrenness and loss.

items.prompt: To support an interpretation, cite the ____ evidence.
